topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture's core themes of cancer evolution and sets out the expected learning outcomes.

topics.label: Clonal Evolution and Epigenetic Drivers of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer initiation and progression are driven by Darwinian selection of genetically mutated clones as well as non-mutational epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Hierarchical Models of Tumor Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how a cell's developmental status within normal tissue hierarchies influences its susceptibility to transformation and drives tumor propagation.

topics.label: The Tumor Microenvironment and Inflammatory Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how environmental promoters, local inflammation, and stromal interactions create permissive conditions that support both incipient and established tumor growth.

topics.label: Methodological Tools for Profiling Tumor Biology
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the experimental, sequencing, and spatial profiling technologies used to investigate tumor evolution and cell-microenvironment interactions.

topics.label: Unified Evolutionary Model of Malignant Progression
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors integrate into an evolutionary framework of cancer outgrowth.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
